Verses.VerseAr: قٓ  ۚ وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡمَجِيۡدِۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Qaf. (Only Allah and the Messenger (blessings and peace be upon him) know the real meaning.) By the Glorious Qur’an,

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ عَجِبُوۡۤا اَنۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مُّنۡذِرٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا شَىۡءٌ عَجِيۡبٌ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But they wondered that a Warner had come to them from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: ‘This is strange!’

Verses.VerseAr: ءَاِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ‌ۚ ذٰلِكَ رَجۡعٌۢ بَعِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Is it that when we are dead and have become dust (then we shall become alive again)? This return is far (from understanding and perception).’

Verses.VerseAr: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنۡقُصُ الۡاَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡ‌ۚ وَعِنۡدَنَا كِتٰبٌ حَفِيۡظٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Definitely We know how much the earth (eats up and) consumes their (bodies) and We have a Book wherein everything is preserved.

Verses.VerseAr: بَلۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِالۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِىۡۤ اَمۡرٍ مَّرِيۡجٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: But (strange and far from understanding is this that) they denied the Truth (i.e. the Messenger and the Qur’an) when it came to them. So they have themselves stepped into anxiety and confusion.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَلَمۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡۤا اِلَى السَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنٰهَا وَزَيَّنّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنۡ فُرُوۡجٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have they not looked at the sky above them how We made it and (how) adorned it, and there is no crack in it?

Verses.VerseAr: وَالۡاَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنٰهَا وَاَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِىَ وَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنۡ كُلِّ زَوۡجٍۢ بَهِيۡجٍ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (in the same way) We spread out the earth and We placed in it heavy mountains and produced in it every kind of beautiful plants.

Verses.VerseAr: تَبۡصِرَةً وَّذِكۡرٰى لِكُلِّ عَبۡدٍ مُّنِيۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: All that is (a source of) insight, direction and guidance for every servant who turns (to Allah in repentance).

Verses.VerseAr: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبٰرَكًا فَاَنۡۢبَتۡنَا بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ وَّحَبَّ الۡحَصِيۡدِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And We showered blessed water from the sky and then produced with it gardens and (also) the grain of harvests,

Verses.VerseAr: وَالنَّخۡلَ بٰسِقٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلۡعٌ نَّضِيۡدٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And date-palms soaring high with layers of spathes.

Verses.VerseAr: رِّزۡقًا لِّلۡعِبَادِ‌ ۙ وَاَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا‌ؕ كَذٰلِكَ الۡخُـرُوۡجُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (This all is done as) sustenance for the servants and We gave life with this (water) to the dead earth. In like manner is (your) coming forth from the graves.

Verses.VerseAr: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ وَّاَصۡحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُوۡدُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Before these (disbelievers of Makka) the people of Nuh (Noah) and the People of the blind well (ar-Rass in al-Yamama), and Thamud (the People of Salih, in the town of al-Hijr near Tabuk on the Madina-Syria road),

Verses.VerseAr: وَعَادٌ وَّفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَاِخۡوَانُ لُوۡطٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And ‘Ad (the people of Hud in Ahqaf valley of Yemen situated between Oman and the al-Mahra) and Pharaoh (the ruler of Egypt) and the People of Lut [Lot] (living in Sodom and ‘Amura [Gomorrah] in Palestine),

Verses.VerseAr: وَّاَصۡحٰبُ الۡاَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعٍ‌ؕ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the inhabitants of al-Aika (the Wood in Madyan, the People of Shu‘aib) and the people of Tubba‘ (the people of As‘ad Abu Kurib al-Himiri, the King of Yemen) (in sum) all (of them) rejected the Messengers. So My promise of punishment (against them) proved true.

Verses.VerseAr: اَفَعَيِيۡنَا بِالۡخَـلۡقِ الۡاَوَّلِ‌ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِىۡ لَبۡسٍ مِّنۡ خَلۡقٍ جَدِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So are We tired by the first creation? (No way!) In fact it is they who are in doubt about the new creation.

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهٖ نَفۡسُهٗ   ۖۚ وَنَحۡنُ اَقۡرَبُ اِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ الۡوَرِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Assuredly We created man and We know (also) the doubts which his (ill-commanding) self puts (into his heart and mind). And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.

Verses.VerseAr: اِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى الۡمُتَلَقِّيٰنِ عَنِ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: When the two receivers receive (the recording angels write down his every communication and work), sitting on the right and on the left,

Verses.VerseAr: مَا يَلۡفِظُ مِنۡ قَوۡلٍ اِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيۡبٌ عَتِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Not a word does he utter with the mouth but a watcher is there beside him ready (to write it).

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ الۡمَوۡتِ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ مَا كُنۡتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيۡدُ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the stupor of death comes with the Truth. (O man,) that is what you were running away from!

Verses.VerseAr: وَنُفِخَ فِىۡ الصُّوۡرِ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ الۡوَعِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the Trumpet will be blown. It is this (torment) the Day of Warning.

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآٮِٕقٌ وَّشَهِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And every soul will appear (before Our Presence), one (angel) forcing it forward and (the other) a witness (to its actions).

Verses.VerseAr: لَّقَدۡ كُنۡتَ فِىۡ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ هٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنۡكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The truth is that you were negligent of this (Day), so We have removed your veil (of negligence) and Today your sight is sharp.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ قَرِيۡنُهٗ هٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيۡدٌؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And his close companion (angel) will say: ‘That is what I have ready (for you).’

Verses.VerseAr: اَلۡقِيَا فِىۡ جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيۡدٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be commanded:) ‘Both of you hurl into Hell every (such) ungrateful rebel,

Verses.VerseAr: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدٍ مُّرِيۡبٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Who hinders from good, exceeds the limits, doubts and puts into doubt,

Verses.VerseAr: اۨلَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ فَاَلۡقِيٰهُ فِىۡ الۡعَذَابِ الشَّدِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Who had set up another god besides Allah. So hurl him into fierce torment.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ قَرِيۡنُهٗ رَبَّنَا مَاۤ اَطۡغَيۡتُهٗ وَلٰـكِنۡ كَانَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍۢ بَعِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Now) his (other) companion (Satan) will say: ‘O our Lord, I did not misguide him. In fact he was himself suffering from misguidance of extreme degree.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُوۡا لَدَىَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ اِلَيۡكُمۡ بِالۡوَعِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Allah will say: ‘Do not dispute in My Presence while I have already sent you the warning (of punishment).

Verses.VerseAr: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الۡقَوۡلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَاۤ اَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Command is never changed in My Presence. And nor do I wrong the servants.’

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ نَقُوۡلُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امۡتَلَئْتِ وَتَقُوۡلُ هَلۡ مِنۡ مَّزِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That Day We shall ask Hell: ‘Are you filled up?’ And it will say: ‘Is there any more?’

Verses.VerseAr: وَاُزۡلِفَتِ الۡجَـنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيۡدٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Paradise will be brought close to the pious; it will not be distant at all.

Verses.VerseAr: هٰذَا مَا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ لِكُلِّ اَوَّابٍ حَفِيۡظٍ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (And it will be said to them:) ‘This is what you were promised; (it is meant) for everyone who turns to Allah in repentance and who guards (his Din [Religion] and Faith),

Verses.VerseAr: مَنۡ خَشِىَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبٍ مُّنِيۡبِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Who fears the Most Kind (Lord) unseen and comes (before the Presence of Allah) with a heart turned in repentance.

Verses.VerseAr: اۨدۡخُلُوۡهَا بِسَلٰمٍ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ الۡخُلُوۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Enter it in peace; this is the Day of Eternity.’

Verses.VerseAr: لَهُمۡ مَّا يَشَآءُوۡنَ فِيۡهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: All those blessings which they will long for will be there for them in that (Paradise) and there is still another blessing with Us (or much more; so the lovers will be enchanted).

Verses.VerseAr: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنۡ قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ اَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا فَنَقَّبُوۡا فِىۡ الۡبِلَادِؕ هَلۡ مِنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And how many generations We destroyed before them (the disbelievers and idolaters of Makka) who were far stronger in power and might than they! So they searched the cities (of the world) to run away somewhere for refuge (from death or torment).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ فِىۡ ذٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرٰى لِمَنۡ كَانَ لَهٗ قَلۡبٌ اَوۡ اَلۡقَى السَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيۡدٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: There is indeed sure warning and admonition in it for him who has a heart (vigilant and awake, far from negligence,) or listens with active attention (i.e. focuses attention having no contact with anyone other than Allah) and is in a state of (spiritual) vision (i.e. remains lost in the effulgent disclosures of Allah’s absolute beauty and charisma).

Verses.VerseAr: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِىۡ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ‌ۖ وَّمَا مَسَّنَا مِنۡ لُّغُوۡبٍ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And surely We have created the heavens and the earth and that (universe) which is between the two in six periods and no fatigue has touched Us.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡبِرۡ عَلٰى مَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوۡعِ الشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ الۡغُرُوۡبِ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So be patient with what they say and glorify your Lord with praise before sunrise and before sunset.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَاَدۡبَارَ السُّجُوۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And also glorify Him during some hours of the night and after the Prayers as well.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ الۡمُنَادِ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍ قَرِيۡبٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And listen attentively (of the Day) when a caller will call from a near place,

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ الصَّيۡحَةَ بِالۡحَـقِّ‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ الۡخُـرُوۡجِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when people will assuredly hear a mighty roar. That will be the Day of coming out from the graves.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡىٖ وَنُمِيۡتُ وَاِلَيۡنَا الۡمَصِيۡرُۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely it is We Who give life and it is We Who cause death and to Us is the return.

Verses.VerseAr: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ الۡاَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعًا‌ؕ ذٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيۡرٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: The Day when the earth will split apart from above them, they will come out in haste. This raising them alive (i.e. gathering the people once again) is quite easy for Us.

Verses.VerseAr: نَحۡنُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ‌ وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِجَـبَّارٍ‌ فَذَكِّرۡ بِالۡقُرۡاٰنِ مَنۡ يَّخَافُ وَعِيۡدِ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We know best what they say and you are not the one to coerce them. So advise by means of the Qur’an anyone who fears My threat of punishment.
